title: Practice: tool errors that an agent can act on (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 a failed call becomes a structured error with a category a retry flag and an error flag
cases.says: A failed call becomes an error with a category, a retry flag and a message, and an error result with the error flag

cases.id: e1 a generic message or an unknown category is refused
cases.says: A generic message and an unknown category are refused

cases.id: e2 only transient failures are retried with growing waits and the other kinds return at once
cases.says: Only transient failures are retried, with doubling waits; the other kinds return at once, with their message and explanation

cases.id: e3 the retries are bounded and a wait the service asks for is honoured
cases.says: The retries are bounded, the wait a service asks for is honoured and the give-up message names the attempts

cases.id: e4 a valid empty result is a success and not an error
cases.says: A valid empty result is a success, not an error

cases.id: e5 a timeout on a write is an unknown outcome and is retried only when repeating it is safe
cases.says: A timed out write is an unknown outcome and is retried only with a key or when read only, with the same key each time and the caller's map untouched

cases.id: e6 the next action follows the category
cases.says: The next action follows the category

cases.id: e7 an unexpected exception becomes an internal error and the run goes on
cases.says: An unexpected exception becomes an internal error and the run goes on
